investigations.incidentDescription: During release testing of Atorvastatin Calcium Batch BATCH-2026-045, HPLC chromatographic purity assay revealed related substance Impurity D at 0.28% w/w, exceeding the approved specification limit of NMT 0.15% w/w. Secondary crystallization slurry temperature profile exhibited abnormal 4.2°C oscillation during anti-solvent addition.
investigations.expectedSpecification: Related Impurity D: NMT 0.15% w/w. Slurry crystallization temperature: 22.0°C ± 1.0°C continuously.
investigations.actualObservation: Related Impurity D measured at 0.28% w/w (re-test confirmed 0.27% w/w). Anti-solvent feed vessel TT-401 experienced sensor lag and thermal swing up to 26.2°C.
investigations.potentialQualityImpact: High potential impact on finished formulation shelf-life and stability profile. Potential degraded solubility kinetics in solid oral dosage form.
investigations.immediateContainmentActions: Quarantine of Batch BATCH-2026-045 placed in Room Q-104 under physical and SAP lock. Upstream intermediate batches BATCH-2026-046 & 047 placed on analytical hold.
investigations.relevantEquipment: Reactor R-301 (Glass-lined 5000L), Temperature Transmitter TT-401, Cryogenic Chiller Loop CH-02
investigations.rawMaterials: Methanol USP (Lot MTH-984), Purified Water (Loop PW-01), Anti-solvent Heptane (Lot HEP-331)
investigations.processParameters: Anti-solvent addition rate: 12.5 L/min; Agitation speed: 85 RPM; Crystallization hold time: 4.5 hours

investigations.incidentDescription: Net batch yield was 64.2% against theoretical validation baseline of 82.0% - 87.0%. Excessive cake heel retention observed in Peeler Centrifuge PC-102 basket mesh with partial blinding.
investigations.expectedSpecification: Yield: 82.0% - 87.0%; Residual mother liquor moisture: NMT 4.5%
investigations.actualObservation: Yield was 64.2%. 48.5 kg unpeeled wet mass remained adhered to centrifuge filter cloth backing screen.
investigations.potentialQualityImpact: Substantial batch economic loss; required solvent washing risk assessment on residual cake integrity.
investigations.immediateContainmentActions: Cake heel sampled and isolated. Filter mesh disassembled for metallurgical and fiber elongation audit.
investigations.relevantEquipment: Peeler Centrifuge PC-102, Fluid Bed Dryer FBD-04
investigations.rawMaterials: Isopropanol HPLC Grade, Magnesium Methoxide 8% in Methanol
investigations.processParameters: Basket speed: 1200 RPM, Nitrogen blanket pressure: 15 mbar, Wash ratio: 1.8 L/kg

investigations.incidentDescription: Bioburden bio-indicator and bacterial endotoxin testing on post-jet-milled API sample exceeded alert threshold (0.45 EU/mg vs alert limit of 0.25 EU/mg; specification limit is 0.50 EU/mg).
investigations.expectedSpecification: Bacterial Endotoxin: NMT 0.25 EU/mg (internal alert limit), NMT 0.50 EU/mg (compendial release limit)
investigations.actualObservation: Measured 0.45 EU/mg in final milling hopper composite sample.
investigations.potentialQualityImpact: High risk of injectable finished product pyrogenic contamination if reconstituted into parenteral vials.
investigations.immediateContainmentActions: Batch placed on Critical Quarantine. Jet mill nitrogen supply inline 0.2µm sterile gas filters isolated for integrity testing.
investigations.relevantEquipment: Spiral Jet Mill JM-03, Isolator Glove Box ISO-01, Sterile Nitrogen Supply Line N2-Sterile
investigations.rawMaterials: Pharmaceutical Grade Nitrogen, Sterile HDPE Liners
investigations.processParameters: Grinding pressure: 7.2 bar, Feed rate: 4.8 kg/hr, Isolator Differential Pressure: +45 Pa
availableSupportingDocuments: Filter Integrity DOP & Bubble Point Test

investigations.incidentDescription: Loss on Drying (LOD) parameter transient alarm triggered at 0.62% (Target: NMT 0.50%). Operator paused discharge conveyor for 12 minutes to adjust heated air velocity.
investigations.actualObservation: Transient alarm for 7 minutes, settled back to 0.38% after air velocity stabilization.
investigations.potentialQualityImpact: Negligible. Re-blend uniformity confirmed acceptable moisture across entire composite.
investigations.immediateContainmentActions: Sampled drum 01 to 05 separately; all passed specification.
investigations.relevantEquipment: Rotary Drum Dryer RD-01, Infrared Moisture Meter IR-02
investigations.processParameters: Inlet air temperature: 95°C, Drum speed: 6 RPM

fiveWhys.question: Why did Batch BATCH-2026-045 fail the purity specification for Impurity D (0.28% vs NMT 0.15%)?
fiveWhys.evidence: QC CoA #CoA-9921 HPLC chromatogram peak area retention time 14.2 min.
fiveWhys.aiAnswer: Elevated levels of related substance Impurity D formed during secondary crystallizer slurry nucleation.
fiveWhys.userNotes: Confirmed by dual HPLC assay runs in QC Laboratory.

fiveWhys.question: Why was Impurity D formed at higher rates during crystallization?
fiveWhys.evidence: DeltaV SCADA trend log reveals 4.2°C exothermic temperature oscillation up to 26.2°C during heptane anti-solvent addition.
fiveWhys.aiAnswer: The localized reaction mixture temperature exceeded the thermal degradation threshold of 23.5°C during anti-solvent dosing.
fiveWhys.userNotes: Kinetics study previously showed Impurity D doubling rate per +3°C above 23°C.

fiveWhys.question: Why did the slurry temperature elevate to 26.2°C rather than maintaining 22.0°C ± 1.0°C?
fiveWhys.evidence: Cryogenic Chiller valve modulation logs show chilled glycol flow valve CV-102 failed to open beyond 28% despite thermal demand signal.
fiveWhys.aiAnswer: The cooling jacket feedback loop experienced pneumatic actuator mechanical sticking.
fiveWhys.userNotes: Actuator stem had minor grease solidification and particulate accumulation.

fiveWhys.question: Why did the cooling valve actuator stick during this manufacturing campaign?
fiveWhys.evidence: Work Order #WO-8831 indicates preventive maintenance was deferred by 45 days due to campaign scheduling pressure.
fiveWhys.aiAnswer: Preventive valve stem refurbishment and lubricant replacement exceeded the validated 180-day service interval.
fiveWhys.userNotes: Maintenance interval extended without formal Quality Risk Assessment (QRA).

fiveWhys.question: Why was preventive maintenance deferred without a formal Quality Risk Assessment?
fiveWhys.evidence: Standard Operating Procedure SOP-MAINT-044 did not mandate QA approval for scheduling deferrals under 60 days.
fiveWhys.aiAnswer: Procedural governance gap in engineering maintenance deferral policy allowed critical GMP utility equipment maintenance postponement without quality risk evaluation.
fiveWhys.userNotes: Confirmed systemic procedural root cause requiring immediate SOP revision and change control.

man.factor: Operators did not manually abort anti-solvent addition when temperature crossed 24°C alarm threshold
man.evidence: SCADA alarm acknowledged but feed continued for 14 minutes

man.factor: Shift handover communication lacked specific alert on sticky valve behavior noted on prior batch

machine.factor: Control valve CV-102 pneumatic actuator mechanical stem binding
Temperature transmitter TT-401 experienced 18-second thermal lag in thermowell oil bath

method.factor: SOP-MAINT-044 allowed maintenance deferral without mandatory QA risk assessment sign-off
Lack of automatic feed interlock cut-off on crystallization reactor over-temperature alarm

material.factor: Heptane anti-solvent lot HEP-331 temperature was 24.8°C at bulk storage drum
Intermediate API crude cake purity was normal (99.4%)

measurement.factor: HPLC method system suitability passed all RSD and resolution criteria
Thermowell sensor response time verification not included in routine 6-month calibration checklist

motherNature.factor: Crystallization cleanroom HVAC ambient temperature elevated to 24.5°C during external heatwave

hypotheses.causeDescription: Pneumatic valve mechanical sticking on reactor cooling jacket caused localized thermal excursion leading to Impurity D degradation.
hypotheses.supportingEvidence: SCADA temperature trend spike, actuator bench test failure, Impurity D kinetics curve.
hypotheses.opposingEvidence: No cooling valve alarm triggered on operator HMI.

hypotheses.causeDescription: Raw material Heptane solvent contamination or lot-to-lot impurity catalytic reaction.
hypotheses.supportingEvidence: New solvent drum lot HEP-331 utilized for this specific batch.
hypotheses.opposingEvidence: GC residual solvent test passed CoA specification; re-testing confirmed clean solvent blank.
hypotheses.missingEvidence: Trace metal ICP-MS screening on heptane lot.

hypotheses.causeDescription: Procedural lack of hard interlock shutting down anti-solvent pump on high-temperature deviation.
hypotheses.supportingEvidence: Pump continued dosing for 14 minutes during 25°C - 26.2°C temperature excursion.
hypotheses.opposingEvidence: Batch record directed operator to notify supervisor rather than immediate manual e-stop.
hypotheses.missingEvidence: Historical run logs for other batches in same campaign.

INV-2026-001.description: HPLC purity chromatogram showing Impurity D at 0.28% w/w with peak retention at 14.2 minutes.
Official production batch record pages 42-58 detailing crystallization anti-solvent addition and operator sign-offs.
Continuous 1-second temperature and chilled glycol valve modulation trace demonstrating 4.2°C oscillation.
Post-incident calibration and valve actuator mechanical stroke inspection findings confirming stem adhesion.

INV-2026-001.documentName: Shift Operator Interview Notes - Shift B
INV-2026-001.description: Structured witness interview with primary crystallizer operator regarding alert acknowledgment and feed pump action.

capaActions.actionDescription: Rebuild and re-calibrate cooling control valve CV-102 on Reactor R-301 with fluoropolymer high-temp seals and pneumatic actuator replacement.
capaActions.scientificJustification: Eliminates mechanical friction and hysteresis in glycol flow modulation, restoring thermal response time to under 4 seconds.
capaActions.verificationMethod: Post-overhaul 10-point stroke verification and 4-hour mock crystallization water-run temperature stability qualification (±0.5°C).
capaActions.effectivenessCheck: Review 3 consecutive commercial API-101 batches post-restart for temperature stability and Impurity D levels.

capaActions.actionDescription: Implement automated PLC safety interlock in DeltaV DCS to immediately pause anti-solvent feed pump P-201 if crystallization slurry temperature exceeds 23.5°C for >30 seconds.
capaActions.scientificJustification: Prevents human latency and ensures kinetic window for Impurity D synthesis cannot be breached during unexpected utility interruptions.
capaActions.verificationMethod: IQ/OQ software change control protocol and challenge test with simulated high-temp sensor input.
capaActions.effectivenessCheck: Zero occurrences of uninhibited feed during thermal alarms over 12 months.

capaActions.actionDescription: Revise SOP-MAINT-044 (Equipment Maintenance Scheduling & Deferrals) to mandate Quality Assurance approval and formal Quality Risk Assessment (ICH Q9) for any calibration or PM deferral on GMP-critical systems.
capaActions.scientificJustification: Closes organizational governance vulnerability that permitted critical utility maintenance postponement without quality impact evaluation.
capaActions.verificationMethod: Quality Management System document release and mandatory training records for 100% of engineering and operations personnel.
capaActions.effectivenessCheck: Quarterly QA audit of all maintenance work orders for compliance with deferral approval protocol.

capaActions.actionDescription: Replace spiral jet mill JM-03 sterile nitrogen intake 0.2µm PTFE hydrophobic cartridge filter and perform pre-use and post-use bubble point integrity test.
capaActions.scientificJustification: Cartridge filter integrity failure allows microscopic ambient spore ingress during gas expansion phase.
capaActions.verificationMethod: Automated Palltronic Flowstar IV integrity test with documented water intrusion pressure curve.
capaActions.effectivenessCheck: Endotoxin testing on 5 sequential milling batches below 0.10 EU/mg.
